in_hebrew.name: Idoux
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Idoux הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'idous', meaning 'idol' or 'image'. In Christian context, it is interpreted as 'God's gift'.

in_greek.name: Idoux
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's gift
in_greek.long_meaning: Idoux είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'idous', meaning 'idol' or 'image'. In Christian context, it is interpreted as 'God's gift'.

in_latin.name: Idoux
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Idoux est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'idous', meaning 'idol' or 'image'. In Christian context, it is interpreted as 'God's gift'.
